titles.title: depmap dataset for python year 3 course

descriptions.description:
Gene dependency data from DepMap Public 25Q2.

Cell lines with more than 50 NaN values for Genes were eliminated.

The remaining NaN values were filled with the median gene dependcy values across all cell lines for 

the specific gene.

Cell line information was concatenated.

Data download and processing was performed using duckdb and pandas.

titles.title: Epithelial WNT secretion drives niche escape of developing gastric cancer

descriptions.description: WNT signaling plays a crucial role in cancer development, with APC as the primary tumor suppressor in colon cancer. In gastric cancer, WNT signaling is essential for epithelial maintenance and driving tumor progression. However, the mechanisms of WNT self-sufficiency remain unclear, as APC and CTNNB1 mutations are relatively rare. Using human and mouse gastric organoids and in vivo mouse models, we found that mesenchymal WNTs maintain the normal gastric epithelium, while KRAS activation induces epithelial WNT secretion, enabling WNT self-sufficiency. Single-nucleus multiomics revealed that KRAS-driven MAPK signaling activates SMAD2/3, unlocking the WNT7B locus and generating WNT7B+ niche cells within the epithelium. In human gastric cancer, epithelial WNT production is driven by either HER2-mediated KRAS–MAPK activation or WNT2 amplification. Analysis of human cancer cell line data further suggests that the KRAS–MAPK–WNT7B axis is conserved in other tumor types, including lung cancer. Our findings identify epithelial WNT secretion as a key mechanism of WNT self-sufficiency in gastric tumorigenesis. Unlike APC or CTNNB1 mutations in colon cancer, this process is targetable, offering potential therapeutic opportunities. This dataset includes data from the DepMap Public 24Q4 release (https://depmap.org/portal/), available under CC BY 4.0 license.

descriptions.description: This DepMap Release contains new cell models and data from Whole Genome/Exome Sequencing (Copy Number and Mutation), RNA Sequencing (Expression and Fusions), Genome-wide CRISPR knockout screens. Also included are updated metadata and mapping files for information about cell models and data relationships, respectively. Each release may contain improvements to our pipelines that generate this data so you may notice changes from the last release. For more information, please see README.txt.
